integrity: All formulas and coefficientwise checks are supplied with a standalone reproducible Python program. No independence, journal acceptance, or external certification is claimed.
limitations: The theorem is for F_2(K_{m,n}) with m,n>=2, labelled configurations and open-neighborhood total domination. Higher token counts, arbitrary host graphs and independent priority certification are not established.
title: The complete total-domination polynomial of two-token complete bicliques
